events.title: Bergen County's Winter Wonderland 2026-2027
events.location: Van Saun County Park, 216 Forest Ave
events.cost_text: Ticketed; free for children 3 and under. Skate rentals $5, bumper cars $12 a ride
events.description: The county's winter festival at Van Saun Park: open-air ice skating, bumper cars, carousel rides, live music, food trucks and an indoor/outdoor beer garden. Santa's North Pole Workshop is listed for select days only, and the ticket page does not say which days. Online tickets are for one admission on the date you pick, and only All-Access tickets include skating.
